text:
emily: Compliance ping — they need a line-by-line change lineage export for routing/policy changes (who changed what + reason + resolved subject) for the last 90d. Can we do NDJSON streaming for large tenants?
rajiv: We can. main constraints: actor resolution (SSO vs service account), PII redaction, and perf when streaming backfill.
lina: UI question — do we expose export filters in Console (by team/route/model) or only via API? Compliance prefers console for ad-hoc.
marco: Console is ok but backend needs a risk flag: streaming exports should not include raw email unless tenant opts in. default should be hashed_identity + id mapping file.
emily: Yeah, compliance asked for both: human-readable actor for audits and a machine mapping artifact for secure storage. Prefer per-export toggle.
rajiv: Proposal: export record shape NDJSON with fields: ts, actor_id, actor_display (nullable), actor_display_source, change, route, policy_id, reason, request_id. And a separate manifest file for mapping actor_id -> resolved_display if export includes PII.
marco: sample NDJSON line:
```
{"ts":"2026-02-03T12:34:56Z","actor_id":"u_123","actor_display":"alice@acme.com","actor_display_source":"idp:azuread","policy_id":"route-23","route":"payflow-prod","change":{"op":"update","diff":"-allow
+deny"},"reason":"emergency rollback","request_id":"r_987"}
```
ops-bot: note: large NDJSON exports will be emitted via signed GCS URL and a streaming job; will surface progress events to audit_events stream.
samir: Two operational asks: 1) pagination/partial download resume support, 2) an endpoint to validate export shape before triggering (so infra can run a quick sanity check).
lina: UX: console filter chips: time range, team, policy id, route prefix, actor (resolved or id), export format, include_pii toggle. Show estimated row count and estimated bytes.
emily: Nice. Privacy note: must include a checkbox and a warning modal when include_pii=true explaining retention/legal. Also audit the export trigger (who exported, when, criteria) as an immutable event.
rajiv: Implementation plan: 1) add fields to change_event row schema (actor_display_source, reason), 2) export generator service that streams ndjson with manifest, 3) console flow with checkbox + estimate + confirm modal, 4) telemetry events for export_start/export_complete/export_fail.
marco: Perf check — streaming backfill for 90d for big tenant ~200M events. We should offer sampling modes (full, sampled, delta since seq) and a sanity throttle.
emily: Can we include a 'delta-since' token (checkpoint) producers can reuse? That will make repeat exports faster.
rajiv: yes, export manifest can contain checkpoint token and event ranges.
samir: Ops: add RBAC so only roles with export privilege see the button and record export job. Also retention policy for exported artifacts (default 30d).
lina: UX follow-ups: show export job list in console with ability to revoke/delete artifact and an audit detail view.
emily: Next steps: Rajiv to draft API shape + NDJSON sample, Marco to estimate perf/cost and sampling modes, Lina to wire mockups for console flow. I'll sync with legal on wording for pii modal. :thumbsup:
rajiv: I'll put a doc in the eng-platform backlog and tag infra + security.
marco: Will run a quick cost model and post numbers in this thread tomorrow.
emily: Thanks all, keeping this as the canonical thread for requirements.
